trans-unit.source: Ewww! What's with that bug freak!? I think I need a bath now!

trans-unit.source: And he plucked the Royal Crest of Alvanista, which is just great.

trans-unit.source: I think this is his way of inviting us to the Zodiac Tower.

trans-unit.source: We must get the crest back...

trans-unit.source: Yeah, and we planned to meet the spirit in that tower anyway.

trans-unit.source: It's south of Midgard, so let's hurry.
